description: An expanded combat teaching module covering Initiative, range, cover, Protection, Shapechanger Living Soak, temporary forms, equipment, Vitality, Exposure, Cohesion, Archetype Pressure, environmental actions, Downed characters, stabilization, revival, and death through one continuous thirteen-round encounter.

entries.title: Combat Foundation Procedure
entries.summary: Combat proceeds in Initiative order through rounds and turns, with one Standard Action, one Move, one Minor Interaction, and one Reaction per participant.
body: Combat begins when opposed declarations make timing consequential. Before Initiative, establish where everyone is standing, what each participant can perceive, which objects provide cover, current Vitality, Cohesion, Exposure, Resource, Pressure, and the immediate objectives that brought the confrontation to violence.

Initiative equals Finesse + Composure. Act from highest Initiative to lowest. Break ties with Awareness, then Finesse, then one unmodified d10 roll between the tied participants. The same order repeats every round unless a capability changes it.

Each round represents approximately six seconds. On a turn, a character receives one Standard Action, one Move of up to 8 meters, and one Minor Interaction. The Standard Action may become another Move or Minor Interaction. A character also receives one Reaction per round, refreshed at the start of that character's turn.

Physical Defense Difficulty equals the ceiling of Guard divided by two, minimum 1. Partial Cover adds 1, Substantial Cover adds 2, Medium range adds 1, and Long range adds 2. Total Cover prevents a direct attack unless the attack can cross or destroy it. Direct Disruption attacks normally use half Identity Defense instead of Guard.

A hit occurs when attack successes equal or exceed Defense Difficulty. Margin is the number of successes beyond the difficulty. Raw Damage equals the weapon's Damage rating plus Margin. Impact and Trauma subtract Protection; Disruption normally ignores ordinary Protection.

Protection is not the last possible defense. After Protection establishes remaining damage, a printed Soak or resistance may remove more. Reactive reductions such as Cohesion Brace occur after Soak. Only damage still remaining removes Vitality. This order matters because Shapechanger Living Soak can reduce the minimum one point left by Protection all the way to zero.

entries.title: Shapechanger Living Soak in Combat
entries.summary: Shapechangers possess a second defensive layer after Protection: a form-dependent Resilience roll that can erase all remaining Impact or Trauma from a successful hit.
body: Living Soak is an innate Shapechanger capability. It is not ordinary Armor, not Cohesion, and not Regeneration. Protection subtracts a fixed amount from incoming physical damage. Living Soak then rolls against whatever remains. The attack may hit, penetrate enough to leave one or more points after Protection, and still remove no Vitality because the transformed body absorbs, disperses, seals, or expels the injury.

In social form, a Shapechanger rolls Resilience only and may Soak Impact damage only. Trauma still represents a body being pierced, cut, burned, or otherwise seriously injured before the character has released a more powerful form.

In hunting or war form, roll Resilience + Archetype Rating after every hit that leaves Impact or Trauma damage. Each success removes one point. The roll costs no Fury, action, Minor Interaction, or Reaction. It occurs once per hit and can reduce the remaining damage to zero.

Living Soak does not reduce Disruption. A noospheric arc, identity fracture, memory weapon, or comparable direct attack is not asking whether claws, bullets, or blunt force can destroy the body. It attacks the continuity operating through that body. This is why a lower-Damage Disruption weapon can be more dangerous to a Shapechanger than a much larger conventional rifle.

Increasing Resilience is exceptionally valuable because it improves two different defenses. Protection rises immediately because Protection equals Resilience + Armor. The Living Soak pool also rises because it contains Resilience. Massive Shift therefore makes a Resilience-focused Shapechanger harder to injure twice: less damage survives Protection, and more dice are available to erase what remains.

Armor configurations such as Siege Form: Bulwark add another fixed layer before Living Soak. Restraint, cover loss, or a high attack Margin can make the Shapechanger easier to hit without disabling either Protection or Soak. An attacker may therefore land an excellent shot and still accomplish no physical damage.

Wounded applies normally. Because Living Soak is a Resilience test, a Wounded Shapechanger loses one Soak die. Staggered or another penalty applying to all tests can reduce it further. Even under those penalties, a high-Rating Shapechanger may remain extraordinarily difficult to injure physically.

Living Soak does not remove Pressure, Exposure, a failed Death Test, or a Death Mark not produced by incoming damage. It also cannot stop an effect explicitly marked as ignoring Shapechanger Soak. These exclusions prevent physical durability from becoming universal immunity.

entries.title: Exposure, Cohesion, Pressure, Vitality, and Death in Combat
entries.summary: The major combat tracks answer different questions: injury, immediate overcommitment, deliberately spent inner stability, and Archetype-specific escalation.
body: Vitality measures remaining functional survival. Impact, Trauma, and Disruption all remove current Vitality one point for one point after all applicable defenses. At 0 Vitality, the character becomes Downed and Unstable. Damage remaining after reaching 0 becomes Death Marks.

Exposure measures immediate operational overcommitment. A Push rerolls failed dice up to Resolve and adds 1 Exposure after the final result. At half the Exposure Limit, rounded up, the character becomes Exposed and rerolls one fewer die with future Pushes. At the Limit, the action still resolves before Overexposure inflicts 1 Impact ignoring Protection, removes the Reaction, and temporarily prevents another Push.

Cohesion is deliberately spent. Commit spends 1 before a roll for two dice. Brace spends 1 after Soak to reduce remaining Impact or Disruption by 1. Anchor spends 1 and a Reaction to support an ally's Death Test or qualifying control test. Refuse Collapse spends 2 once per scene to remain at 1 Vitality instead of becoming Downed.

Archetype Pressure is separate from Exposure. Resource is paid, printed Pressure is marked, and the ability resolves. Warning or Critical effects begin after the action crossing that threshold. At the Limit, the action resolves before the Crisis. Pressure remains after Initiative ends until the Archetype's own recovery procedure removes it.

A newly Downed character receives the remainder of that round as a grace period. If still Unstable, the first Death Test occurs at the end of the following round. Roll Resilience + Composure against difficulty 2. Failure adds 1 Death Mark, or 2 when the failed roll contains a 1. At 3 Death Marks, death is immediate.

Stabilize is an adjacent Standard Action using Reason + Medicine at difficulty 2 with a field medical kit or difficulty 3 without one. Success makes the target Stable and removes one Death Mark. Emergency Treatment requires a Stable adjacent target at 0 Vitality, difficulty 3, and one kit charge on success; it restores 1 Vitality, removes one Death Mark, and leaves the target Staggered through the end of the next turn.

All characters use these procedures. A hostile Shapechanger remains physically difficult to injure while standing, but Living Soak cannot erase a failed Death Test after the Shapechanger is already Downed. Physical toughness delays the death spiral; it does not replace the death rules.

entries.title: Expanded Worked Combat: Three People in the Cargo Gallery
entries.summary: Mara Vale and Ilyan Voss confront Kest Raal across thirteen rounds. The example explains every major action, why equipment and forms change the numbers, how Shapechanger Living Soak dominates physical exchanges, and how rescue and death occur under the same rules.
body: The encounter begins with conversation. Mara Vale, a Human Investigator and field medic, stands on the eastern loading platform with a compact pistol holstered and a rifle slung across her back. Ilyan Voss, an Eldritch Binder carrying the Abyssal Womb, remains four meters behind her beside a damaged plasma conduit. Kest Raal, a Shapechanger in social form, stands twenty-eight meters away behind the waist-high housing of a cargo loader. Mara asks him to return a stolen biological access key. Kest answers that the key belongs to whoever can keep it and declares that he is crossing the gallery to tear Ilyan apart. That declaration makes order consequential, so Initiative begins.

The gallery establishes several mechanical facts before any dice are rolled. Twenty-eight meters is Medium range, adding 1 to Physical Defense Difficulty. The cargo-loader housing gives Kest Partial Cover, adding another 1. The emergency bulkhead halfway down the gallery can become Total Cover when closed. The damaged conduit can be repaired, but ignoring it for too long will create an environmental hazard. Initiative is Mara 6, Kest 5, Ilyan 4.

Mara has 7 Vitality, Guard 6, Protection 3 from Resilience 2 and light Armor 1, 5 current Cohesion, and Exposure Limit 5. Her compact pistol deals Damage 4 Trauma; her rifle deals Damage 5 Trauma. Her pistol is easier to keep ready, while the rifle has greater raw damage. Her field medical kit has two charges and lowers Stabilize difficulty from 3 to 2.

Ilyan has 7 Vitality, Guard 4, Protection 3, 3 Cohesion, 6 Pact, 4 Intrusion against Limit 8, and an arc pistol dealing Damage 3 Disruption. The arc pistol's number is lower than Mara's rifle, but Disruption ignores ordinary Protection and cannot be reduced by Living Soak. Ilyan's weapon attacks the continuity operating through the target rather than trying to penetrate flesh and Armor.

Kest begins with Resilience 4, 9 Vitality, Guard 6, Protection 4, Archetype Rating 3, 11 Fury, 4 Instinct against Limit 7, and 4 Cohesion. In social form, Living Soak can roll Resilience against Impact only; it cannot Soak Trauma. In hunting or war form, it rolls Resilience + Archetype Rating against Impact or Trauma. Kest is a First Fang Wilds Shapechanger, so prolonged artificial confinement can trigger Cage Fury and increase Instinct.

Stage One — Opening at Range. Round 1, Mara fires her compact pistol before Kest can close. Finesse 3 + Firearms 3 gives six dice and five successes. Kest's base Physical Defense Difficulty is 3, increased to 4 by Medium range and 5 by Partial Cover. Mara exactly meets difficulty, so Margin is 0. Raw Damage is the pistol's 4 Trauma. Protection 4 would reduce this to 0, but an ordinary successful physical hit retains a minimum of 1 at the Protection step. Kest is still in social form and social-form Living Soak cannot affect Trauma, so he loses 1 Vitality, falling from 9 to 8. The bullet does not simply bounce away; it penetrates, and Kest's human-looking body has not yet released the deeper form capable of closing around it.

Round 1, Kest uses his Minor Interaction to shift into war form. The change costs 1 Fury, reducing Fury from 11 to 10. His frame lengthens, joints reverse, and dense living tissue forms around the wound. The shift itself does not restore the lost Vitality. It changes what later hits may be Soaked. Kest spends another Fury on Mark the Prey, designating Ilyan and reducing Fury to 9, then moves 8 meters. The distance to Mara is now twenty meters, inside Short range.

Round 1, Ilyan fires the arc pistol through the open gallery. His four-die pool produces only two successes against Kest's Identity Defense Difficulty 3. The shot misses. Its pale electrical shape crawls across the loader housing without touching Kest's continuity. No damage, Exposure, Pact, or Intrusion changes because Ilyan did not Push or activate a pact ability.

Round 2, Mara fires again. The first roll produces only two successes against difficulty 3. She Pushes three failed dice because Resolve is 3. The replacement dice raise the total to four successes and add 1 Exposure after resolution. Margin 1 raises Raw Damage to 5. Protection 4 leaves 1 Trauma. Kest now makes Living Soak with Resilience 4 + Archetype Rating 3, rolling seven dice. Two successes remove the remaining point, reducing final damage to 0. Mara hit him; the shot reached his body; Protection failed to erase it completely; Living Soak then sealed and displaced the injury before Vitality was lost. Kest remains at 8 Vitality while Mara accepts Exposure for no lasting damage.

Round 2, Kest activates Massive Shift and chooses Resilience. The ability costs 1 Fury, reducing Fury to 8, and adds Archetype Rating 3 to Resilience for the scene. Resilience rises from 4 to 7. Vitality Maximum rises from 9 to 12, and current Vitality rises by the same three points, from 8 to 11. This is temporary functional mass, not the healing of the earlier recorded Trauma. Protection rises from 4 to 7. Living Soak rises from seven dice to ten. Kest then moves another 8 meters, leaving twelve meters between himself and Mara.

Round 2, Ilyan fires again at Short range. Three successes meet Identity Defense Difficulty 3. Disruption Damage 3 ignores Kest's Protection 7 and Living Soak cannot roll against it. Kest falls from 11 to 8 Vitality. The effect is described as a brief loss of agreement between Kest's new mass and the identity directing it: muscles remain physically intact, but their ownership signal stutters.

Stage Two — Protection and Soak Escalate. Round 3, Mara draws her rifle as her Minor Interaction and spends 1 Cohesion on Commit before attacking, reducing Cohesion from 5 to 4 and raising the rifle pool from six dice to eight. Five successes against difficulty 3 produce Margin 2. Rifle Raw Damage is 7 Trauma. Protection 7 again leaves the physical-hit minimum of 1. Kest's ten-die Living Soak produces three successes and removes that point. The rifle is more destructive than the pistol and Mara rolled well, but increasing Raw Damage from 5 to 7 does not matter when Protection still reduces the result to one and the second defensive layer removes it.

Round 3, Kest activates Siege Form and selects Bulwark. The ability costs 2 Fury, reducing Fury from 8 to 6. Bulwark adds Armor 2, raising Protection from 7 to 9, but halves Kest's movement from 8 to 4 meters. Dense overlapping plates lock across the war form. This is a tactical trade: conventional attacks become even less useful, but Kest closes distance more slowly and remains easier to contain.

Round 3, Ilyan invokes Dream-Born Servitor as a Warden. It costs 2 Pact and 1 Intrusion, changing Pact from 6 to 4 and Intrusion from 4 to 5. The servitor appears as several black jointed arms unfolding from an angle too shallow to contain them. Resolve 4 + Archetype Rating 2 gives six dice and three successes against Kest's Defense Difficulty 3. The Warden Restrains Kest with durability 5. Restraint does not injure him and therefore triggers no Soak; it changes movement and Defense Difficulty instead.

Round 4, Mara attacks the Restrained target. Restrained reduces Kest's Physical Defense Difficulty from 3 to 2. Mara's first rifle roll produces one success, so she Pushes three dice and raises the final result to four successes. Exposure increases from 1 to 2. Margin 2 again produces Raw Damage 7. Bulwark Protection 9 leaves the minimum 1 Trauma, and Living Soak removes it. The restraint made Kest easier to hit but did not weaken his Armor or transformed tissue.

Round 4, Kest uses Break Free. Force 4 + Athletics 3 gives seven dice against difficulty 3, calculated from the restraint's durability 5. Three successes end Restrained. The Standard Action is spent, which prevents Kest from attacking or activating another Standard Action this turn.

Round 4, Ilyan fires the arc pistol. Three successes meet Identity Defense Difficulty 3. The 3 Disruption bypasses Bulwark Protection 9 and Living Soak, reducing Kest from 8 to 5 Vitality. Kest is now Wounded because 5 is at or below half of his temporary Maximum 12. Wounded removes one die from Force, Finesse, and Resilience tests. His Living Soak pool falls from ten dice to nine, but remains formidable.

Round 5, Mara fires the rifle without Pushing. Four successes produce Margin 1 and Raw Damage 6. Bulwark Protection 9 leaves the minimum 1. The Wounded nine-die Soak pool produces one success, again reducing damage to 0. Kest has now ignored three successful Trauma attacks in war form, including two rifle hits, without spending Fury or a Reaction on the Soak rolls.

Round 5, Kest dismisses Bulwark as his Minor Interaction, returning movement to 8 meters and Protection to 7. He activates Pursuit Through Systems for 1 Fury and 1 Instinct. Fury falls from 6 to 5; Instinct rises from 4 to 5, crossing the Critical Threshold. The ability allows doors, machinery, crowds, and terrain to impose fewer delays while he follows Ilyan. Predatory Focus and Challenge Reflex now govern his choices after this action, but the ability itself resolves before those Critical effects begin.

Round 5, Ilyan activates The Thousand-Armed Scheme. It costs 2 Pact and 2 Intrusion, changing Pact from 4 to 2 and Intrusion from 5 to 7. Five immediate effects resolve: unseen arms pull Mara behind Substantial Cover; close the emergency bulkhead between Kest and the eastern platform; move a cargo crate across the most direct path; grant Ilyan Armor 2 until his next turn; and attempt to Restrain Kest. The restraint roll fails, but the other four selected effects remain because each is an independent immediate effect. Intrusion 7 is Critical, but Ilyan was not Critical before spending Pact, so Partial Occupancy does not add another point to this activation.

Stage Three — The Gallery Becomes a Weapon. Round 6, the closed emergency bulkhead gives Total Cover. Mara cannot simply fire through it. She instead uses Reason 4 + Security 2 to engage the damaged locking dogs. Her first roll produces two successes against difficulty 3. She Pushes three dice, succeeds, and raises Exposure from 2 to 3. Exposure Warning is 3, so Mara becomes Exposed and can reroll one fewer die on later Pushes. The reinforced lock will force Kest to break the bulkhead rather than open it normally.

Round 6, Kest changes Siege Form from Bulwark to Breacher, paying the 2 Fury cost again and reducing Fury from 5 to 3. Bulwark Armor ends, so Protection returns to 7. Breacher adds three dice against barriers and ignores 2 Armor on structures. Wounded reduces the Force-based pool by one, but Kest still attacks the bulkhead with nine dice. The first impact buckles it without opening a passage. Because an artificial enclosure has prevented Kest from moving more than 2 meters for a complete round, the First Fang Wilds Bane Cage Fury raises Instinct from 5 to 6.

Round 6, Ilyan spends 1 Pact on Other Eye and chooses Resonance, reducing Pact from 2 to 1. The sense immediately reveals structural stress through the closed bulkhead, allowing him to tell Mara which seam will fail first. Ilyan was already at Critical Intrusion before spending Pact, so Partial Occupancy adds 1 Intrusion after the ability resolves. Intrusion reaches Limit 8. The Resonance information remains valid; then Incursion occurs. The Abyssal Womb's printed Breach Restrains Ilyan through the end of his next turn and pulls three unsecured objects, including the arc pistol, from his hands. He suffers 1 Disruption, falling from 7 to 6 Vitality, and gains the Abyssal Source Mark. Intrusion resets to Warning 3 with no overflow.

Round 7, Mara follows Ilyan's warning. She moves behind a load-bearing cargo strut and uses Guard, increasing her Defense Difficulty by 1 until her next turn. This is not wasted inactivity: Total Cover prevents a useful shot, so Mara uses the turn to improve her position before the bulkhead fails.

Round 7, Kest attacks the identified seam. Breacher ignores part of the bulkhead's structural Armor, and the second blow tears a human-width opening through it. Kest then uses his Move to cross the ruined threshold. Pursuit Through Systems explains why twisted machinery and the partly collapsed door do not consume the entire turn. The Standard Action was spent destroying the bulkhead, so he cannot also attack Mara or Ilyan.

Round 7, Ilyan remains Restrained but spends his final Pact on the Abyssal Womb's Far Hand. The black arm reaches five meters, retrieves the displaced arc pistol, and places it back in his hand. Pact falls from 1 to 0. Intrusion remains 3 because he is no longer Critical. The fixed restraint ends at the conclusion of his turn. At 0 Pact he cannot activate further Pact-cost abilities, but equipment and ordinary actions remain available.

Round 8, Mara fires from Short range. Five successes produce Margin 2 and Rifle Raw Damage 7. Kest currently has Protection 7 because Breacher provides no Armor. Protection leaves the minimum 1 Trauma. Wounded Living Soak rolls nine dice and removes it. The round demonstrates why losing Bulwark does not make Kest fragile: Massive Shift still supports both Protection and Soak.

Round 8, Kest ends Breacher and activates Apex Shape for 2 Fury and 1 Instinct, reducing Fury from 3 to 1 and raising Instinct from 6 to its Limit of 7. He chooses wall-and-ceiling movement, natural weapons with +2 Damage, and the limitation of no speech. Apex Armor 2 raises Protection from 7 to 9. The transformation resolves first: Kest becomes a low, broad organism gripping the overhead rails, and his claws now deal Damage 6 Trauma. Then Rampage occurs. Instinct resets to Warning 3. The activation turn counts as the first of the three Rampage rounds, even though Kest has already spent his Standard Action.

Round 8, Ilyan fires the recovered arc pistol. The first roll produces one success, so he Pushes three failed dice. The final total reaches three successes, Exposure increases from 0 to 1, and the attack hits Identity Defense Difficulty 3. Disruption 3 ignores Apex Protection 9 and Living Soak, reducing Kest from 5 to 2 Vitality. Kest's body remains physically massive and plated, but the command structure animating it is beginning to fail.

Stage Four — Rescue Under a Rampaging Apex. Round 9, Mara spends 1 Cohesion on Commit, reducing Cohesion from 4 to 3, and fires eight rifle dice. Six successes against difficulty 3 create Margin 3 and Raw Damage 8. Apex Protection 9 leaves the minimum 1 Trauma. The Wounded nine-die Soak pool produces one success and removes it. This is the clearest demonstration of the advantage: Mara produces an exceptional rifle hit, yet the combination of fixed Protection and rolled Soak still prevents every point of Vitality loss.

Round 9, Kest is in the second Rampage round and must pursue the marked quarry, Ilyan. Wall movement carries him over Mara's cover and directly above the Binder. Mark the Prey contributes one attack die. Force 4 + Close Combat 3 + one marked-quarry die − one Wounded die gives seven dice. Six successes against Ilyan's Defense Difficulty 2 create Margin 4. Apex claws deal base Damage 6, producing Raw Damage 10. Ilyan's Protection 3 leaves 7 Trauma. He had 6 Vitality after Incursion, so he falls to 0 with one damage remaining and gains 1 Death Mark. He becomes Downed and Unstable. The round in which he falls is his grace period, so he makes no Death Test yet.

Round 10, Mara moves adjacent to Ilyan and uses Stabilize with the field medical kit. Reason 4 + Medicine 3 gives seven dice against difficulty 2. The first roll produces only one success. Because Mara is Exposed, Resolve 3 allows only two Push rerolls rather than three. The replacements succeed, Exposure rises from 3 to 4, and Ilyan becomes Stable. Stabilize removes his single Death Mark but does not restore Vitality; he remains Downed at 0.

Mara uses the rest of her Move to drag Ilyan four meters behind the cargo-loader housing. Dragging a willing, unconscious, or Downed character uses movement at half speed. The housing becomes Total Cover from Kest's present angle. This positioning is what keeps the rescue from being immediately undone.

Round 10, the third and final Rampage round forces Kest to reach the marked quarry. Ilyan is behind Total Cover, so Kest attacks the cargo-loader housing blocking the route. The structure absorbs the attack but partially collapses. Kest does not receive a free attack on Ilyan merely because he destroyed the obstacle; the Standard Action is spent.

Round 11, Mara performs Emergency Treatment. Ilyan is adjacent, Stable, and at 0 Vitality, satisfying the prerequisites. Mara spends 1 Cohesion on Commit, reducing Cohesion from 3 to 2, and rolls nine dice against difficulty 3. Four successes remove one recorded Trauma, restore Ilyan to 1 Vitality, remove any remaining Death Mark, end Downed, and apply Staggered through the end of his next turn. One medical-kit charge is consumed. Kest's Rampage restriction has ended before his Round 11 turn.

Round 11, Kest shoulder-slams Mara away from Ilyan. The attack leaves 2 Impact after Protection. Mara spends 1 Cohesion on Brace, reducing Cohesion from 2 to 1 and the remaining Impact from 2 to 1. Brace functions because the damage is Impact; it could not reduce Kest's claw Trauma. Mara falls from 7 to 6 Vitality.

Round 11, Ilyan acts at 1 Vitality while Staggered. Staggered removes one die from the arc-pistol pool, leaving three dice. The initial roll fails, but a Push of two failed dice reaches three successes and raises Exposure from 1 to 2. Disruption 3 would reduce Kest from 2 Vitality to 0 with one excess damage. Kest spends 2 Cohesion on Refuse Collapse, reducing Cohesion from 4 to 2. He remains at 1 Vitality instead and becomes Staggered through the end of his next turn. Refuse Collapse can be used only once in the scene.

Round 12, Mara fires at the one-Vitality Shapechanger. The shot hits and leaves 1 Trauma after Protection. Kest's Soak pool is reduced by Wounded and Staggered, falling from ten dice to eight, but it still produces a success and erases the damage. Being one point from collapse does not switch Living Soak off. The attack would have killed an ordinary unprotected target; Kest's transformed body still refuses it.
Round 12, Kest attacks Mara while Staggered. The lost die causes the shoulder slam to miss her Defense Difficulty. His Staggered condition ends after the turn.

Round 12, Ilyan fires again. The first roll fails. He Pushes, reaches three successes, and increases Exposure from 2 to 3. Exposure Warning for Limit 6 is 3, so Ilyan becomes Exposed. The 3 Disruption reduces Kest from 1 Vitality to 0 with two excess points. Kest gains 2 Death Marks and becomes Downed and Unstable. He cannot use Refuse Collapse again because he already used it this scene. Living Soak cannot reduce Disruption.

Stage Five — Attempted Rescue and Death. Round 13, the damaged plasma conduit ruptures. Mara can either treat Kest immediately or prevent the gallery from becoming an active fire hazard. She chooses the conduit, not because hostile characters automatically die, but because an uncontrolled plasma event threatens everyone. Reason 4 + Engineering 1 gives five dice against difficulty 3. The first roll produces two successes. Mara is Exposed, so she can Push only two dice. Both succeed. The conduit seals and Exposure reaches Limit 5. The repair resolves first; then Overexposure inflicts 1 Impact ignoring Protection, removes Mara's Reaction, prevents another Push through her next turn, and resets Exposure to Warning 3. Mara falls from 6 to 5 Vitality.
Round 13, Kest is Downed and receives no action. This is the round after he fell, so a Death Test will occur at the end of the round if he remains Unstable.

Round 13, Ilyan chooses to try to save the person who nearly killed him. Mara and her medical kit are occupied at the conduit, so Ilyan attempts Stabilize without a kit at difficulty 3. Reason 3 + Medicine 1 gives four dice. The first roll produces one success. Because Ilyan is Exposed, he may reroll only three failed dice despite Resolve 4. The Push raises Exposure from 3 to 4 but reaches only two successes. Stabilize fails, so Kest remains Unstable with 2 Death Marks.

At the end of Round 13, Kest makes a Death Test. Massive Shift still supplies Resilience 7, but Wounded reduces the Resilience-based pool by one; with Composure 2, he rolls eight dice against difficulty 2. The result contains only one success and one die showing 1. The failed Death Test therefore adds 2 Death Marks. Kest reaches at least 3 and dies immediately. Living Soak cannot affect this result because no incoming Impact or Trauma is being Soaked. The death comes from the unresolved Downed state and failed continuity of the body, not from a weapon penetrating his Armor.

The final state preserves every track rather than erasing it because Initiative ended. Mara has 5 of 7 Vitality, 1 Cohesion, and Exposure 3 after Overexposure reset. Ilyan is conscious at 1 of 7 Vitality, has 0 Pact, Intrusion 3, Exposure 4, and an Abyssal Source Mark because Intrusion has not fallen below Warning. Kest is dead at 3 or more Death Marks. The example shows that the Shapechanger was by far the hardest participant to injure physically, yet not invulnerable to Disruption, Pressure, restraint, tactical isolation, or the death procedure.
